sections · 0.3.0 · aj-s-chat

Ask's conversation (v4 C2): the head row (the drawers' pills, then New on today or Today on a past day; sticky at the top, its pills in the middle of its paper, the paper fading at its foot and its sides; on desktop level with the wordmark), the thread (the open day's sessions in time order, each with its line, its messages as bubbles), the chat composer at the foot. States: the day, an empty session (the composer's lead asks what to ask), loading (a whole page of skeleton resting on the composer).

token--aj-s-chat-minexposed: The section's least height, default 0px: the page gives it the screen less what is above it, so the composer starts at the foot.
token--aj-s-chat-screenexposed: Its height while a day loads, default 100dvh: the page sets the screen less its own head.
token--aj-s-chat-footexposed: The composer's height and a little more, written by the script on the section, never by a parent: a jump lands clear of it.
statedefaultyes: the day's sessions and messages, the composer at the foot
statehoveryes: the lead's questions darken their edge; the bubbles and pills carry their own
statefocus-visibleyes: the product's ring on the pills, the questions, the bubbles' tools and links, the composer
stateactiven/a: the controls carry their own press
statedisabledyes: a past day, read only: Today in the head row, the read-only slip
stateselectedn/a: nothing in the thread is chosen; a bookmark's arrival flashes once
stateloadingyes: loading (the skeleton page); an answer being written (the bubble's own)
stateerroryes: a can't-answer (the bubble's own) with the lead's questions; a failed question (unsent bubble, the words back in the box, the lead's note)
stateemptyyes: an empty session: blank above the composer, whose lead asks what to ask

Today

Today’s two sessions, the second still open; New at the end of the head row.

Session 1 · 08:10

What do I write about when I can’t sleep?

Sleep comes up in eleven of your entries since June. Nine of them were written after ten at night (6 Aug), and most are less about the night than about the next day: work you haven’t started, a call you keep putting off.

The nights you slept well, you had been out walking first (3 Jul).

2 entries used
  • Slept badly again. I’ve stopped counting which night this is.Thursday 6 August, 22:10
  • Walked to the canal after work. The swans were exactly where they always are, which I found more reassuring than it probably is.Friday 3 July, 18:20

Was July any better?

A little. You wrote about sleep four times in July and said twice that you slept well (3 Jul). Both times you had been outside in the evening.

1 entry used
  • Walked to the canal after work. The swans were exactly where they always are, which I found more reassuring than it probably is.Friday 3 July, 18:20

Session 2 · 21:40, open

When did I last feel properly calm?

Sunday the 2nd. You walked the canal as far as the second bridge and wrote that you didn’t listen to anything (2 Aug).

Before that, the last time you used the word calm was 14 June, on another walk past the water (14 Jun).

2 entries used
  • Walked the canal as far as the second bridge and back. Didn’t listen to anything.Sunday 2 August, 17:05
  • Took the long way round past the water. Two swans and a heron that left before I got close.Sunday 14 June, 11:30

Session 2 · 22:30

What have I said about the office lately?

Mostly that it’s loud. In the last three weeks you mention the office six times, and four of those are about noise or not being able to think (29 Jul).

The one good day was the Thursday you worked from the library (23 Jul).

2 entries used
  • The office is too much lately. I put headphones on just so nobody talks to me.Wednesday 29 July, 12:45
  • Worked from the library. Got more done before lunch than all of Tuesday.Thursday 23 July, 16:10

How have things been with Mum?

Warmer than in the spring. In March and April most entries about her end on an argument (28 Mar); since June they end on plans: the garden, the coast in September (30 Jun).

2 entries used
  • Rang Mum. Same conversation as last week, same ending.Saturday 28 March, 20:15
  • Mum wants to do the coast in September. I said yes before I thought about it, and I’m glad.Tuesday 30 June, 19:40
